name: Thumula S.
text: An excellent experience at Lotus Edge in Matale! The property is beautifully maintained with a stunning lobby and dining area. The staff was incredibly welcoming and provided top-notch service throughout my visit. Whether you are stopping by for a meal or attending an event, it's a fantastic location. Highly recommended!

name: Taniya S.
text: Had a wonderful experience at Lotus Edge Restaurant & Lounge! ❤️ Everything was amazing, from the delicious food to the excellent service and beautiful atmosphere. The staff were very friendly, welcoming, and attentive throughout our visit. The food was fresh, tasty, and beautifully presented, and the whole place had such a lovely and relaxing vibe. Really enjoyed every part of the experience. Thank you, Lotus Edge, for making our visit so special! ❤️ Definitely a place I would love to visit again. Highly recommended!
